stage.name: The Grand Knight Territory Outskirts
stage.description:
A large-scale competitive exhibition game organized by the Kazimierz General Chamber of Commerce. As a defender, Rhodes Island must make use of sponsor drones to deal with the Knightclubs' elites.
<Special Conditions> DP will not regenerate naturally.

nameless_elite_knight.name: Nameless Elite Knight
nameless_elite_knight.flavourText: An independent Kazimierz knight with some degree of achievement, though not enough to inspire any confidence. Sooner or later, they'll probably get swallowed up by the competition.

nameless_independent_knight.name: Nameless Independent Knight
nameless_independent_knight.flavourText: An independent Kazimierz knight. A low profile and unrefined skill means this one will soon be swept away in the tide of knight competition.

hound.name: Hound
hound.flavourText: A creature controlled by a Reunion recon squad. Monitoring equipment is strapped to its body. Due to their speed and evasiveness, they can easily slip through enemy defenses and cause heavy damage.

roar_knightclub_elite.name: Roar Knightclub Elite
roar_knightclub_elite.flavourText: Wearing the high-performance, lightweight armor provided by Roar Guards, this new batch of experimental armor has some humorous deficiencies, and even though these are battle-hardened knights, they have still been reduced to pitiful test subjects. 'Roar Guards, even the winds will bow to you!'
abilities: Has significantly increased DEF and RES for a period of time

training_gloompincer.name: Training Gloompincer
training_gloompincer.flavourText: Infected creatures commonly found in the great lakes and rivers of Kazimierz, captured and raised by casters and used as tools to train knights and entertain fight spectators.

vicious_training_gloompincer.name: Vicious Training Gloompincer
vicious_training_gloompincer.flavourText: Infected creatures commonly found in the great lakes and rivers of Kazimierz, these male gloompincers are fed special hormones and made more aggressive than the regular ones. They're a cruel tool to train knights and entertain fight spectators.

roar_knightclub_trainee.name: Roar Knightclub Trainee
roar_knightclub_trainee.flavourText: Wearing the high-performance, lightweight armor provided by Roar Guards, this new batch of experimental armor has some humorous deficiencies that made these people into pitiful test subjects. 'Roar Guards, even the winds will bow to you!'
abilities: Has significantly increased DEF and RES for a period of time

authorized_caster.name: Authorized Caster
authorized_caster.flavourText: A basic caster soldier. Arts have been one of the most threatening forms of warfare since ancient times, and a large amount of research has gone into adapting Arts for contemporary warfare.

hound_pro.name: Hound Pro
hound_pro.flavourText: A creature controlled by a Reunion recon squad that is more dangerous than a normal Hound. Monitoring equipment is strapped to its body. Due to their speed and evasiveness, they can easily slip through enemy defenses and cause heavy damage.

monster_mk_ii.name: Monster Mk II
monster_mk_ii.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone that has been upgraded from its namesake model, the Monster MkII. Equipped with a small gun and a long-range Arts receiver, they are likely operated by concealed Casters. Though unlikely to cause heavy damage to armored Operators, they can still pose a considerable threat.
abilities: Flying unit.

shielded_guard_leader.name: Shielded Guard Leader
shielded_guard_leader.flavourText: A standard melee-range soldier. They are more dangerous than normal Shielded Guards Their lightweight riot shields provide them both offensive and defensive flexibility. In battle, they pose a substantial threat to our front lines.

defender_4.name: Defender-4
defender_4.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone known as the Defender-4. Though they do not have any offensive capabilities, they must be taken care of due to their ability to support enemy troops.
abilities: Flying unit.
Increases the DEF of surrounding enemy units

shielded_guard.name: Shielded Guard
shielded_guard.flavourText: A standard melee-range soldier. Their lightweight riot shields provide them both offensive and defensive flexibility. In battle, they pose a substantial threat to our front lines.

ergate.name: Ergate
ergate.flavourText: An engineer that specializes in sabotage, almost never seen wielding weapons. Though unarmed, they utilize their agility and cunning to slip through defenses in order to sabotage mechanical and electrical equipment.
abilities: Cannot be blocked.

ergate_leader.name: Ergate Leader
ergate_leader.flavourText: An engineer that specializes in sabotage, almost never seen wielding weapons. Though unarmed, they utilize their agility and cunning to slip through defenses in order to sabotage mechanical and electrical equipment. They are more difficult to deal with than normal Ergates.
abilities: Cannot be blocked.

elite_knight_shielder.name: Elite Knight Shielder
elite_knight_shielder.flavourText: An independent Kazimierz knight, with more expensive equipment, on the verge of finding a sponsor. In the ever-changing competition circuit, relying on defense to steadily rack up points is an effective strategy.

independent_knight_shielder.name: Independent Knight Shielder
independent_knight_shielder.flavourText: An independent Kazimierz knight. In the ever-changing competition circuit, relying on defense to steadily rack up points is an effective strategy.

bloodboil_knightclub_elite.name: Bloodboil Knightclub Elite
bloodboil_knightclub_elite.flavourText: A regular knight from the Bloodboil Knightclub. The Bloodboil Knights have long been known for their ferocity and aggression, from trainees to knight nobles. Whenever one of their brothers falls, they gain courage and combat prowess.
abilities: Each time an enemy is defeated, gains ATK and ASPD, stacking up to 10 times.

bloodboil_knightclub_trainee.name: Bloodboil Knightclub Trainee
bloodboil_knightclub_trainee.flavourText: A trainee from the Bloodboil Knightclub. The Bloodboil Knights have long been known for their ferocity and aggression, from trainees to knight nobles. Whenever one of their brothers falls, they gain courage and combat prowess.
abilities: Each time an enemy is defeated, gains ATK and ASPD, stacking up to 10 times.

blade_helmet_knightclub_trainee.name: Blade Helmet Knightclub Trainee
blade_helmet_knightclub_trainee.flavourText: A trainee from the Blade Helmet Knightclub. This order of young competition knights chose the name of the ancient heroes of Kazimierz. In fact, they exhibit only arrogance and complacency from that extinct lineage. They are good at picking fights and don't go down easily.
abilities: Significantly decreases ATK of the unit with the highest ATK for a period of time
Rebirth

blade_helmet_knightclub_elite.name: Blade Helmet Knightclub Elite
blade_helmet_knightclub_elite.flavourText: A regular knight from the Blade Helmet Knightclub. This order of young competition knights chose the name of the ancient heroes of Kazimierz. In fact, they exhibit only arrogance and complacency from that extinct lineage. They are good at picking fights and don't go down easily.
abilities: Significantly decreases ATK of the unit with the highest ATK for a period of time
Rebirth

frost.name: Frost
frost.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone equipped with heavy armor to make it harder to destroy. Its prototype was designed by a graphics engine studio. They are equipped with a special device that allows them to drastically reduce the temperature around them, greatly decreasing the attack speed of nearby Operators.
abilities: Flying unit.
All friendly units within range have reduced ASPD

oneiros.name: Oneiros
oneiros.flavourText: An unmanned, slow-flying enemy drone equipped with a special warhead released upon approaching Operators that inflicts Arts damage and a freezing effect in an area. Modified from the Bombtail, they lost their ability to accelerate after delivering the payload in order to accomodate a special warhead.
abilities: Flying unit.
Can launch a warhead to deal AoE Arts damage and apply the Cold effect to targets

corrupted_knight.name: Corrupted Knight
corrupted_knight.flavourText: A Sarkaz knight with a broken horn who radiates terror and shows clear signs of excessive drug use. Uses a warhammer in battle. Crushes enemies with terrifying bloodlust. When the Withered Knight falls, takes up the quest and becomes dramatically stronger. Every step he takes spreads corruption.
abilities: Attacks deal Physical damage to the target and adjacent allied units
Does charged attacks, dealing heavy Physical damage to the targets and any adjacent units
Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed when <Withered Knight> dies

withered_knight.name: Withered Knight
withered_knight.flavourText: A Sarkaz knight with a broken horn who radiates terror and shows clear signs of excessive drug use. Uses a cursed bow in battle. Can shoot multiple targets at once and plant seeds of withering arts. When the Corrupted Knight falls, takes up the quest and becomes dramatically stronger. Knights that are hostile to him will shift to Wither.
abilities: Attacks 2 targets simultaneously
Fires explosive arrows at three targets which explode after a short delay, dealing high Arts damage to the target and surrounding four tiles
Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed when <Corrupted Knight> dies
